description: This file defines configuration options and a validator class for Azure Cosmos DB clustering within the Orleans framework. It includes a class for setting clustering options with a default container name and a validator class for validating these options.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring Azure Cosmos DB clustering, inheriting from CosmosOptions, with a default container name set to 'OrleansCluster'.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for CosmosClusteringOptions, inheriting from CosmosOptionsValidator, used to validate clustering options.

methods.name: CosmosClusteringOptions
methods.description: Constructor initializing the clustering options with default container name.

methods.name: CosmosClusteringOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor for the validator class, initializing with options and name, and passing them to the base validator.
